name: Nexus-Mods/Vortex
description: Open-source mod manager from Nexus Mods supporting 250+ games including Skyrim, Fallout, and Cyberpunk 2077, with automated load order management, mod profiles, and deep Nexus Mods platform integration.
score_rationale: The most widely used general-purpose mod manager with 1.3k stars, GPL-3.0, actively maintained through March 2026, and backed by the largest mod hosting platform.
summary: Most popular mod manager for 250+ games with automated load ordering
